about: S14 fix 3 (feat/pine-s14-udt-reader-depth, NUMBER PENDING): the depth `udtTypeOf` bounds its walk with travels through `fieldPathOf` and back, so a binding named like a namespace no longer loops until the stack overflows. Every hop of the depth, dropped once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: udtTypeOf asks fieldPathOf with the depth dropped
fieldPathOf asks udtTypeOf with the depth reset to 0
mutants.from: if (bound && bound.kind === 'expr') type = udtTypeOf(bound.node, scope, depth + 1)
